verdict.rationale: Marlin is a hosted research-agent service, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that it generates reports and PowerPoint slides as deliverables, plus a 'Download all samples' link for vendor sample materials. Neither is a documented capability to export all of a user's data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
